summary: Refit the Ascella static-offset folds from the training configurations alone and score each left-out configuration in counting plus fitted-prediction variance, replacing the full-data start and the counting-only chi-square of the leave-one-configuration-out readout.

reconciliation.note: The owner asked for the narrowing and the training-only folds; the falsifier was fixed in this record before the run.

next_action: Run the preregistered drive-dependent heater family (step drive-dependent-heater-family) under the training-only folds and record its reading.
scope: Training-only leave-one-configuration-out folds of the four Ascella static offset families on job-00, scored in counting plus fitted-prediction variance, and the narrowed physical-model wording; a drive-dependent heater-response family under the same folds remains.

steps.action: Refit every static family per left-out configuration from the zero start on the training configurations and score it with g C g^T.
steps.acceptance: configuration-holdout.json replays within the fit bounds and the preset criterion is applied to every family.

receipts.result: Every static family stays at 30 or more on 10 for X or Y with the prediction variance (X 205, 167, 87, 27; Y 88, 45, 36, 52); the combined family's X is weakly identified (median variance ratio 12.7). Host and runner-image records agree within the fit replay bounds.

steps.action: Fit one drive-dependent heater family, realized phase phi + a_h + k_h phi with phi the returned phase in [0, 2 pi) (heater power linear in phase under phi = A V^2 + b), heater offsets a_h under N(0, 0.3^2) and per-heater slope errors k_h under N(0, 0.1^2), and score it under the same training-only folds and g C g^T variance. The width 0.1 gives a phase spread of 0.31 rad at the mid drive pi, matching the offset prior, and no other width is fitted.
steps.acceptance: Its standardized left-out X and Y sums are recorded against the 30-on-10 criterion, read as fixed here: a sum of 30 or more for X or Y keeps the shortfall and raises confidence that no shared static or drive-linear error of the returned mesh predicts left-out configurations; both sums below 20 with a median prediction-to-counting variance ratio above 1 for that readout reads as weakly identified and leaves confidence unchanged; both sums below 20 with both median ratios at most 1 reads as predicting left-out configurations and lowers it; any other outcome is inconclusive and leaves confidence unchanged.
